entries.title: Allow Peek Inventory
entries.snippet: allowPeekInventory Enables all peek inventory functionality. This rule must be enabled to use peekInventory in your InfoDisplay. It also enables the /peek command and the ability to peek inside containers by holding a spyglass. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Biome Edges
entries.snippet: Biome Edges Usage: /biomeedges add [from: from] [to: to] Creates a visual representation of biome edges in the specified region. Usage: /biomeedges removelast Removes the most recently created biome edge visualization. Usage: /biomeedges clear Removes all biome edge visualizations.

entries.title: Butcher
entries.snippet: Butcher Usage: /butcher [entity: entity] Instantly removes entities without dropping their items. If the entity argument is unspecified, the entity you are looking at is assumed.

entries.title: Camera
entries.snippet: Camera Allows you to switch to a survival-friendly spectator mode, or set up a tripod to view your work on-demand. Usage: /cam place Places down a camera for you to view later on. Usage: /cam view Toggles viewing your placed camera. Your player will still be able to move around and interact as normal while viewing your placed…

entries.title: Claim Projectiles
entries.snippet: Claim Projectiles Usage: /claimprojectiles [radius: radius] [player: player] Makes you (or another specified player) the owner of all projectile within a certain block radius. If no radius is specified, the default is 25 blocks.

entries.title: Cleanup
entries.snippet: Cleanup Usage: /cleanup [radius: radius] Removes all items and xp orbs within 50 blocks, or at a specified distance. Alias: /k

entries.title: Data
entries.snippet: Data Usage: /data [entity: entity] Displays information about blocks or entities. If the entity argument is specified, it will display information about that entity. Otherwise, information about the block or entity you are looking at will be displayed. This includes the its name, location, dimension, properties, states, compo…

entries.title: Debug Entity
entries.snippet: Debug Entity Usage: /debugentity Overlays debug information on selected entities. Not available in realms version.

entries.title: Dimensional Teleport
entries.snippet: Dimensional Teleport Usage: /dtp [destination: destination] [victim: victim] Teleports entities to the specified dimension. If you include coordinates, the victim will be teleported to those coordinates in the specified dimension, otherwise coordinates will keep your current coordinates in the new dimension. entries.title: Distance
entries.snippet: Distance Calculates the cartesian, flat cartesian, and manhattan distances between two points. Usage: ./distance target Calculates the distance in blocks between your head and the block or entity you are looking at down to three decimal places. Note that entity positions are at their foot. Alias: ./d target Usage: ./distance…

entries.title: Entity Density
entries.snippet: Entity Density Usage: /entitydensity [dimension: canopy:dimension] Displays the entity count for each dimension and identifies dense areas of entities in the specified dimension. The dimension argument can be omitted to use your current dimension. Valid dimension names include overworld , nether , end , the end , o , n , and,…

entries.title: Game Information
entries.snippet: Game Information These commands will help you gather information about the world around you.

entries.title: Gamemode
entries.snippet: Gamemode Usage: /c Set your gamemode to creative. Usage: /s Set your gamemode to survival. Usage: /a Set your gamemode to adventure. Usage: /sp Set your gamemode to spectator.

entries.title: Global Rule Setting
entries.snippet: Global Rule Setting Manages which global rules are enabled. These are global rules that affect all players and can be toggled by opped players. Usage: ./canopy menu Displays a menu with toggles for every rule. Flip the switches for the ones you want a hit the submit button at the bottom to save your changes. Requires OP. Usag…

entries.title: Hardcoded Spawn Spots
entries.snippet: Hardcoded Spawn Spots Usage: /hss calculate Finds hardcoded spawn spots (HSSes) near your current position. Stand inside a structure and run this command. Does not work on fortresses. Usage: /hss fortress Finds HSSes using the mob spawning algorithm. May take a few minutes. Spawns are mocked during the search so no mobs will…

entries.title: Health
entries.snippet: Health Usage: /health Profiles the server's tick speed for five seconds, displaying the average ticks per second (TPS) and the milliseconds per tick (MSPT). Also shows the lowest and highest values of each over that time. Additionally, this command also displays the entity count for each dimension.

entries.title: Help
entries.snippet: Help Usage: ./help [page/searchTerm] Displays every command's and every rule's usage and a short description. Default page names include "InfoDisplay", "Rules", and several numbered pages of commands. There is also a page for any loaded extensions. Specifying a search term will display any command or rule that includes that t…

To get set up with a hopper counter, just place a hopper that faces into a wool block. When you place down your first hopper counter, a timer which i…

There are 16 channels, each named after a Minecraft wool color (red, cyan, light blue, etc.). entries.snippet: hopperGenerators Enables/disables the generator command and hopper generator functionality. Disabling this rule also resets all generators. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Info Display Rule Setting
entries.snippet: InfoDisplay Rule Setting Manages which InfoDisplay rules are enabled for you. These are per-player rules and do not affect other players. Usage: ./info menu Displays a menu with toggles for every InfoDisplay rule. Flip the switches for the ones you want a hit the submit button at the bottom to save your changes. Usage: ./info…

entries.title: Jump
entries.snippet: Jump Usage: /jump Teleports you to the block you are currently looking at with a maximum range of 64 chunks. Alias: /j

entries.title: Lifetime Tracking
entries.snippet: Lifetime Tracking This command allows you to track the lifetime and spawning / removal reasons of entities and items in your world. It is particularly useful for debugging and optimizing mob farms. Usage: /lifetimetracking [lifetimeTrackingActions: canopy:lifetimeTrackingActions] Start and stop tracking entity lifetime and sp…

entries.title: Log
entries.snippet: Log Usage: /log [precision: precision] Logs the location of the specified entity type in chat. The precision argument is optional and sets the number of decimal places to truncate the entity location at. There is a maximum of 15 and the default is 3.

entries.title: Loop
entries.snippet: Loop Usage: /loop Runs the specified command a certain number of times in a single tick. Note that the looped command must be encased in quotes.

entries.title: Need Help?
entries.snippet: Need help? Join the Canopy Discord Server for help. [!TIP] Go to the Installation or Commands page to get started!

entries.title: Peek
entries.snippet: Peek Usage: /peek [itemQuery: itemQuery] Show the inventory of the block or entity you're looking at up to 64 chunks away. Using the "search term" argument will highlight any items that include your search term in your InfoDisplay.

entries.title: Player Sit
entries.snippet: playerSit Allows players to sit down anywhere after 3 quick sneaks. Also determines whether the /sit command can be used. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Position
entries.snippet: Position Usage: /pos [player: player] Displays your current position, or the position of another player. Shows dimension and relative nether/overworld position as well.

entries.title: Simulation Map
entries.snippet: Simulation Map Displays a map showing the simulation status of chunks in an area. Ticking chunks are displayed in green and non-ticking chunks are displayed in red. The dimension and x/z coordinates configure the center of the map. The distance argument sets the size of the area to display (in chunks away from the center). Us…

entries.title: Simulation Map
entries.snippet: simulationMap Shows a map of loaded chunks around you or a configured location. Ticking chunks are green; non-ticking chunks are red. Configure with the ./simmap command. Warning: This rule is performance-intensive. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.snippet: Tick Usage: /tick mspt [value: value] Slows the tick loop to the given milliseconds-per-tick value. Must be 50 or greater. Usage: /tick step [value: value] Advances N ticks while the tick loop is slowed. Defaults to 1 step if omitted. Usage: /tick reset Restores tick speed to normal (50 MSPT). entries.title: Understudy
entries.snippet: Understudy Understudy Banner Understudy adds simulated players to Minecraft Bedrock Edition that act almost exactly like real players. Using commands, you can spawn in, control, and interact with these players. This extension is perfect for afking farms, testing redstone contraptions, and more.

entries.title: What Are Extensions?
entries.snippet: What are Extensions? Extensions are additional behavior packs that add additional functionality to Canopy . New rules are accessible through ./canopy and new commands & rules will be listed in ./help . If you would like to learn more about creating your own extension, check out the example repo: Canopy-Extension-Example !

entries.title: Allow Bubble Column Placement
entries.snippet: allowBubbleColumnPlacement Removes the vanilla restriction on placing bubble column items. A soul sand or magma block underneath is still required. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Armor Stand Respawning
entries.snippet: armorStandRespawning Enables/disables armor stands dropping their items and respawning when broken by a projectile. This rule is useful for sorting items with armor stands. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Auto Item Pickup
entries.snippet: autoItemPickup Enables/disables the automatic pickup of items that drop when you break a block. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Biome
entries.snippet: biome Shows the biome at your current location. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Block States
entries.snippet: blockStates Shows the block states of the block you are targeting. Especially useful with Construct , which shows desired block states as you build. Includes waterlogged status. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Cardinal Facing
entries.snippet: cardinalFacing Shows which direction you are facing using cardinal directions (N, S, E, W) and the corresponding coordinate axis (e.g., N (-z)). - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Careful Break
entries.snippet: carefulBreak Automatically picks up items when breaking blocks and sneaking. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Cauldron Concrete Conversion
entries.snippet: cauldronConcreteConversion Concrete powder items inside water cauldrons will convert to concrete after 7 seconds. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Chunk Borders
entries.snippet: chunkBorders Enables chunk border visualization when an arrow is in the inventory slot below your offhand slot. Not available in the realms version. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Chunk Coords
entries.snippet: chunkCoords Shows the coordinates of the chunk you are in and your relative position within that chunk. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Collision Boxes
entries.snippet: collisionBoxes Enables entity collision box visualization when an arrow is in inventory slot 14 (the slot to the right of the top middle slot in your inventory). - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Coords
entries.snippet: coords Shows your coordinates truncated at 2 decimal places. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Creative Hotbar Switching
entries.snippet: creativeHotbarSwitching Allows you to quickly switch between multiple hotbars. With an arrow in the top right of your inventory, sneak and change hotbar slots to cycle through your saved hotbars. For Creative mode use only. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Creative Instant Tame
entries.snippet: creativeInstantTame Enables/disables the ability to tame animals instantly by feeding or mounting them in creative mode. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Creative Nether Water Placement
entries.snippet: creativeNetherWaterPlacement Allows players in creative mode to place water in the Nether. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Creative No Tile Drops
entries.snippet: creativeNoTileDrops Enables/disables items dropping from blocks when breaking them in creative mode. Unlike the vanilla gamerule, this also suppresses drops from containers and only applies when you break them — not when they break in the world. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Creative One Hit Kill
entries.snippet: creativeOneHitKill Allows players in creative to kill entities in one hit. If the player is sneaking, all entities in a small radius will be killed. Does not affect items, xp orbs, or players. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Dimension
entries.snippet: dimension Shows your current dimension's identifier. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Dupe Tnt
entries.snippet: dupeTnt Enables/disables TNT duping. To dupe a block of TNT, it must be moved by a piston while adjacent to a note block, then ignited. The TNT will drop with normal priming momentum in the block below where it was ignited. Note that using this rule alongside tntPrimeMomentum will cause a 1-gametick slowdown before the TNT dr…

entries.title: Durability Notifier
entries.snippet: durabilityNotifier Enables a sound and tooltip when your tool has three hits left before breaking. An additional tooltip appears when your tool has 20 durability remaining. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Durability Swap
entries.snippet: durabilitySwap When your tool hits 0 durability, it is automatically swapped out of your hand. Swap priority: empty slots first, then items that don't take durability damage, then items with durability remaining. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Echo Shards Enable Shriekers
entries.snippet: echoShardsEnableShriekers Using an echo shard on a sculk shrieker allows it to summon wardens. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Ender Pearl Chunk Loading
entries.snippet: enderPearlChunkLoading Allows ender pearls to tick the chunks around them in a square radius. Set to -1 to disable. - Type: integer - Default value: -1 - Suggested options: -1 , 2 , 3 , 4

entries.title: Entities
entries.snippet: entities Shows the number of entities in front of your player. If there are many entities in the world, having this enabled may cause lag. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Entity Instant Death
entries.snippet: entityInstantDeath Removes the 20-gametick entity death animation, removing the entity immediately. Also causes entities not to drop XP. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Entity Separation
entries.snippet: entitySeparation When stacked entities trigger a pressure plate, one entity will be pushed in the direction a neighboring dropper is facing. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Event Trackers
entries.snippet: eventTrackers Shows the counts of currently tracked events. Tracking is controlled with /trackevent . - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Explosion Chain Reaction Only
entries.snippet: explosionChainReactionOnly When enabled, explosions only affect TNT blocks, resulting in chain reactions but no other block damage. Cannot be enabled at the same time as explosionNoBlockDamage or explosionOff . - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Explosion No Block Damage
entries.snippet: explosionNoBlockDamage Enables/disables explosion block damage. Explosions will still damage entities but will not break blocks. Useful for testing TNT-based contraptions in a controlled environment. Cannot be enabled at the same time as explosionChainReactionOnly or explosionOff . - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Sug…

entries.title: Explosion Off
entries.snippet: explosionOff Enables/disables all explosions. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Facing
entries.snippet: facing Shows your exact facing direction using yaw and pitch values. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Flippin Arrows
entries.snippet: flippinArrows Using an arrow on a block will flip, rotate, or open it. Keeping the arrow in your offhand while placing blocks will place them in the opposite direction they would normally face. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.snippet: renderSignalStrength Renders the signal strength of nearby redstone dust in the world. Only renders for redstone dust within 10 blocks from the player to avoid excessive rendering. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Renewable Elytra Drop Chance
entries.snippet: renewableElytraDropChance Gives phantoms a chance to drop elytra when killed by a shulker bullet. Set to 0 to disable. - Type: float - Default value: 0 - Suggested options: 0 , 0.01 , 0.2 , 1

entries.title: Renewable Sponge
entries.snippet: renewableSponge When enabled, guardians struck by lightning will transform into elder guardians. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Server Side Collision Boxes
entries.snippet: serverSideCollisionBoxes Renders entity collision boxes based on their server-side position rather than their client-side position. Useful for debugging desyncs. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Session Time
entries.snippet: sessionTime Shows the elapsed time since you joined the world in this session. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Signal Strength
entries.snippet: signalStrength Shows the redstone signal strength of the block you are targeting. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Slime Chunk
entries.snippet: slimeChunk Shows whether the chunk you are currently standing in is a slime chunk. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Spawn Egg Spawn With Minecart
entries.snippet: spawnEggSpawnWithMinecart When using a spawn egg on a rail, the spawned entity will be placed inside a minecart on that rail. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Speed
entries.snippet: speed Shows your current movement speed in meters per second. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Structures
entries.snippet: structures Shows naturally generated structures present at your current location. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Target
entries.snippet: target Shows the identifier of the block or entity you are targeting. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Time Of Day
entries.snippet: timeOfDay Shows the Minecraft day-cycle time displayed as a 12-hour digital clock. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Tnt Fuse
entries.snippet: tntFuse Sets the TNT fuse time (in ticks) for all TNT. - Type: integer - Default value: 80 - Suggested options: 1 , 10 , 80 , 200 , 72000

entries.title: Tnt Prime Momentum
entries.snippet: tntPrimeMomentum When enabled, gives all TNT a fixed priming momentum in a random direction. Set to -1 to disable. Useful for testing TNT-based contraptions in a controlled environment. - Type: float - Default value: -1 - Suggested options: -1 , 0 , 0.0196

entries.title: Tps
entries.snippet: tps Shows the server's current ticks per second (TPS). - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Velocity
entries.snippet: velocity Shows your current x, y, and z velocity values in meters per tick. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: Weather
entries.snippet: weather Shows the current weather in your dimension. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: World Day
entries.snippet: worldDay Shows the count of Minecraft days elapsed since the world was created. - Type: boolean - Default value: false - Suggested options: false , true

entries.title: 1 Fork And Clone The Repository
entries.snippet: 1. Fork and clone the repository 1. Go to github.com/ForestOfLight/Canopy and click Fork (top right). 2. Clone your fork (use the dev branch): git clone -b dev https://github.com/ /Canopy.git cd Canopy 3. Create a new branch for your translation: git checkout -b translation/fr FR

entries.title: Adding Canopy To Servers
entries.snippet: Adding Canopy to Servers Make sure you add "@minecraft/debug-utilities" to your server's config/default/permissions.json . This is not possible on Realms, and is why Canopy has a separate Realms version.

entries.title: Getting Started
entries.snippet: Getting Started Installing Canopy is fast and easy: 1. Download the latest release from the Releases Page . 2. Open the .mcaddon into Minecraft. 3. Add the Canopy resource and behavior packs to your world. 4. Toggle the BetaAPIs experimental feature on. 5. Profit. For detailed setup and usage instructions, visit the Wiki .

entries.title: Manual Installation
entries.snippet: Manual Installation: 1. Change the .mcaddon file to a zip file and extract it. 1. Place the Canopy [BP] folder in your com.mojang behavior packs folder. 1. Place the Canopy [RP] folder in your com.mojang resource packs folder.

entries.title: Simple Installation
entries.snippet: Simple Installation: 1. Open the .mcaddon file. This should automatically open Minecraft and install the pack. 2. You should now see the pack in your behavior and resource packs list.
